@claude is cat bells in the lake district open all year, and how long does the main route take

I couldn't confirm any official opening times. Catbells is an open fell with no entry fee or permit, so you can walk it in winter. The main route usually takes 2 to 4 hours, depending on the loop. Winter daylight is short and the weather can be rough, so start early.

Source: https://www.walkupscafellpike.co.uk/lake-district-walk/classic-lake-district-walks-walk-up-catbells/
